footer.tagline: A digital gateway for discovering, verifying and connecting Tanzanian mining opportunities with capital, technical capability and services.
footer.noticeBody: MineConnect is a private digital marketplace. It is not a government licensing authority, does not grant or approve mineral rights, and does not guarantee the existence, grade, quantity or economic viability of any mineral. A listing does not mean a right is transferable or approved. Transfers and assignments of mineral rights are subject to the Mining Act (Cap. 123), its regulations and, where required, licensing-authority consent. Platform fees are never government fees. Personal data is processed in line with the Personal Data Protection Act, 2022.

home.how.title: A structured path from first look to final agreement
home.how.inv1.d: Create an investor profile and complete KYC so owners know who they are speaking with.
home.how.inv2.d: Filter by mineral, region, licence type, stage, ticket size and verification level.

home.how.inv5.d: Engage verified geologists, labs and lawyers through the platform.
home.how.inv6.d: Transactions proceed under applicable law, with licensing-authority consent where required.

home.how.own5.d: Qualified investors contact you through the platform; you approve deal-room access.
home.how.own6.d: Answer due-diligence requests and confirm the transaction outcome when complete.
home.ladder.body: Each badge states exactly what was checked, by whom, when — and what was not verified. Verification is never a guarantee of mineral occurrence, grade or economic viability.
home.mapTeaser.body: Explore projects across Tanzania’s goldfields, gemstone belts and critical-mineral provinces. Filter by mineral, licence category, stage and verification level. User-submitted data is always labelled separately from authoritative public sources.
home.audiences.fieldAlt: A Tanzanian geologist and an investor reviewing a map on a tablet at an exploration site
home.audiences.investorsBody: Advanced search, investor alerts, saved projects and private deal rooms — with verification scope stated on every listing.
home.audiences.ownersBody: Present your PML, PL or ML project professionally, earn a verification badge and reach investors who are actively looking — from TSh 50,000 a month.
home.services.title: The professionals every project needs
home.services.body: Geologists, laboratories, drillers, surveyors, environmental consultants, lawyers and equipment suppliers — profiled, moderated and ready to quote.
home.trust.body: Mining opportunities attract both genuine projects and bad actors. Our controls are designed around the risks the sector actually faces.
home.trust.d1: Every listing is reviewed before publication. Guaranteed-mineral claims are prohibited.
home.trust.d2: Owners and investors are identity-checked before protected details are shared.
home.trust.d3: Private documents, NDA tracking, watermarking and a full audit trail of access.
home.trust.d4: Introductions and agreed facilitation terms are logged before contact is released.
home.trust.d5: We are not a licensing authority. Platform fees are always separate from government fees.
home.trust.d6: Report any listing or user. Complaints follow a published escalation procedure.
home.trust.scamBody: MineConnect will never ask you to pay a government fee to us, or to send money to a personal mobile-money number. Never pay deposits outside an agreed, documented process.

verif.subtitle: Every listing carries a verification level from 0 to 4. Each badge records exactly what was checked, by whom, when — and, just as importantly, what was not.
verif.whoBody: Role of the verifier — compliance officer, registered geologist, engineer.
verif.whenBody: Date of the last check, with expiry so stale badges are flagged.
verif.whatNotBody: An explicit list of what the verification does not cover.
verif.not1: It is not a government licence, approval or consent. MineConnect is not a licensing authority.
verif.not2: It is not a mineral-resource or reserve estimate, and never a guarantee of grade, quantity or profitability.
verif.not3: It does not mean a mineral right is transferable. Assignments follow the Mining Act’s statutory process.
verif.not4: It does not replace your own independent legal, technical and financial due diligence.
verif.ctaBody: Verified listings start at TSh 250,000 depending on scope, and receive priority placement in search and on the map.

pricing.feesSubtitle: One-off and success-based fees for owners and investors. Indicative — confirmed in writing before any work.
